Package com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller

Class AvailabilitySlotController

java.lang.Object
com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller.AvailabilitySlotController
@RestController @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()") @RequestMapping("/api/slots") @CrossOrigin(origins="*") public class AvailabilitySlotController extends Object
REST controller for managing availability slots. Provides endpoints to retrieve global slots defined by the admin, as well as slots specific to a given tutor or offer.
Version:
1.2
Author:
EduLink Team

      @GetMapping("/available/{tutorId}") @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()") public List<SlotDto> getAvailableSlotsForTutor(@PathVariable Integer tutorId)

    • getAvailableSlotsExcludingOffer

      @GetMapping("/available/{tutorId}/excluding/{offerId}") @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()") public List<SlotDto> getAvailableSlotsExcludingOffer(@PathVariable Integer tutorId, @PathVariable Integer offerId)
      Retrieves all available time slots for a specific tutor, excluding slots occupied by their other offers (ignoring the current one). Useful when updating an existing offer.
      Parameters:
      tutorId - the ID of the tutor
      offerId - the ID of the offer to be ignored
      Returns:
      list of available SlotDto objects
